issues.problem: chess.com accepts the share-panel PGN's [Result] as proof that the game on screen is finished, with no visibility check and no check that the PGN belongs to that game. In memory, a game in progress with no clock-turn class (daily or bot game) plus a hidden leftover textarea.share-menu-tab-pgn-textarea[readonly] from an earlier finished game (other moves, [Result "1-0"]) opens the gate in AQ.readPosition(), AQ.gate() and AQ.confirm(), and the move list is offered. Every other finished marker is checked for visibility and scope; this one is not. Whether chess.com leaves that textarea in the DOM after the dialog closes is not established, so no H6 cap is applied, but if it does this is a path to an answer during a game.
issues.fix: Pass the visibility function into pgnText() so the textarea (or data-pgn holder) must be visible, and accept its [Result] only when the PGN's movetext matches the on-page move list (same SAN sequence). Simpler: drop PGN [Result] as finished evidence and rely on the move-list result row and the game-over element, which the owner's live capture shows. Add fixtures for a hidden stale share PGN and a visible share PGN of another game on an in-progress page (Adapter, Panel and Browser, zero POSTs).

issues.problem: chess.com variations are read as lines only through data-parent-node, an attribute no captured chess.com markup contains, so on the live site a selected sub-line always falls back to the board (Best move only).

issues.problem: Since fix pass 4, openPanel() hides the launcher and then awaits loadPrefs() on every open. If a one-second launcher tick lands during that await (the service worker waking takes that long), showLauncher() un-hides the launcher, and it stays in the tab order under the open panel until the panel closes. In memory, a 150 ms getPrefs delay left both shown in 1 of 4 opens, and a 1.1 s delay in 4 of 4. A focusable control hidden behind the dialog fails WCAG 2.2 Focus Not Obscured.
issues.fix: Set an `opening` flag (or stop the ticker) before the await and have showLauncher() return while it is set, or set fab.hidden = true again right after panel.hidden = false. Add a panel test with a delayed getPrefs that asserts the launcher is hidden whenever the panel is open.

issues.problem: Only `analysis` is capped at 20,000 characters. The `evaluation` string, the EVALUATION line taken from the uncapped raw analysis, and critical_line_san are not, and plainAnalysis() runs /<!--[\s\S]*?-->/ over them, which is quadratic on repeated "<!--". Measured: a 320 KB evaluation takes 2.6 s in normalized(), so a 2 MB reply (the stream cap) blocks the service worker for well over a minute, during which the 150 s deadline and cancel cannot run in the worker. The whole string is then shown in the Evaluation row. It needs a hostile or broken server.
issues.fix: Cap evaluation and the EVALUATION sentence at about 300 characters and critical_line_san at about 400 before any regex, and drop the row when over. Add a unit test with a long "<!--" run that must return within a few milliseconds.

issues.problem: The cached gate is recomputed only on a URL change, a new board element, or a click or key press. When chess.com renders the move list and result row after the board already exists (Game Review loading, a finished game page hydrating), nothing triggers a recompute, so the launcher stays hidden until the user's first click or key press. Reproduced in memory: 3.3 s after the result row appeared the launcher was still hidden; it appeared about a second after a pointerdown. It fails closed, but the button can look missing on a finished game.
issues.fix: After a URL or board change, re-evaluate the gate on a short backoff (for example at 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 s) before settling into the cached steady state. The idle cost stays the same. Add a panel test where the result row arrives late with no input.

No fixture has a finished game with clock elements, and the live records do not say whether that page type was checked.
